From the coast to the summit

The three builds

Each level is named after a climb up Teide. The car underneath is the same; what changes is how far we take it.

Sea level

Costa

The car as it comes, fully prepared and ready for the coast road.

  • Full service and multi-point inspection
  • Machine polish and deep valet
  • Restored lights, cleaned wheels
  • Warranty included
Our base price
2,100 m

Cañadas

The look. Same car, transformed on the outside.

  • New paint or wrap
  • Concave multi-spoke rims
  • Front and rear lip
  • Ducktail spoiler where it suits
  • Lowering springs
+6k over Costa
3,715 m

Cumbre

The summit. Outside, inside and under the bonnet.

  • Full carbon body kit and forged wheels
  • Lowering springs or air suspension
  • Brand-new interior: leather, fabric, wood or carbon, suede headliner
  • Performance parts: engine upgrade, exhaust, intake, brakes
+11k to +16k over Costa
